text:
My resolutions over the years that truly stuck never began on Jan 1st. Like watching  motivational clip, it never lasted.  
I battled addiction in my early years, really crippling addiction. And it taught me a lot about change. 

A resolution is simply a recognition, a desire for change, and proof we believe we can do better for ourselves. 

We all know we’re capable of much more.  So I try to focus less on what I want to add in life, and more on what I want to stop.
If I can just remove some negative actions, there is a good chance positive naturally fills that space.  It’s that process of stopping the most negative actions that has helped most.  

Happy New Year’s to all.
